# ThinkMarkets

> ThinkMarkets is an award-winning global CFD trading broker offering multi-asset trading across forex, stocks, commodities, indices, cryptocurrencies, and ETFs with tight spreads and advanced trading platforms.

ThinkMarkets provides retail traders with access to 4,000+ instruments through multiple trading platforms including ThinkTrader, MT4, and MT5. The platform emphasizes education, competitive pricing with zero-commission accounts, and risk management tools for traders of all experience levels.
